cohort: The study included 996 singleton pregnancies admitted to a high-risk care unit due to preterm labor (n=519) or premature preterm rupture of membranes (n=477) who underwent vaginal culture examination at admission between January 2005 and April 2019.
finding: Maternal vaginal colonization in premature preterm rupture of membranes (PPROM), but not in preterm labor (PTL), is an independent risk factor for early-onset neonatal sepsis (EONS).
gest_age: The gestational age at admission for the PTL group was approximately 27.2-28.2 weeks, and for the PPROM group, it was approximately 26.1-27.5 weeks.
